mapper.select: SELECT min(ocrn_dt) AS min_ocrn_dt, max(ocrn_dt) AS max_ocrn_dt FROM parking.tb_cvlcpt

WITH c AS ( SELECT emd_cd, count(*) AS cvlcpt_cnt FROM parking.tb_cvlcpt WHERE cvlcpt_type_cd <> '99' AND emd_cd IS NOT NULL AND ocrn_dt >= #{cvlcptBgngDt} AND ocrn_dt < #{cvlcptEndDtExcl} GROUP BY emd_cd ), d AS ( SELECT emd_cd, count(*) FILTER (WHERE crdn_mthd IN ('고정형CCTV', '주행형CCTV', '버스장착형CCTV')) AS cctv_crdn_cnt, count(*) FILTER (WHERE crdn_mthd = 'PDA') AS pda_crdn_cnt, count(*) FILTER (WHERE crdn_mthd IS NULL OR crdn_mthd NOT IN ('고정형CCTV', '주행형CCTV', '버스장착형CCTV', 'PDA')) AS fld_crdn_cnt FROM parking.tb_crdn_dsctn WHERE emd_cd IS NOT NULL AND crdn_dt >= #{crdnBgngDt} AND crdn_dt < #{crdnEndDtExcl} GROUP BY emd_cd ), s AS ( SELECT emd_cd, sum(coalesce(pklt_cpcty, 0)) AS pklt_cpcty_sum FROM parking.tb_pblpklt WHERE ownshp_type_nm IS DISTINCT FROM '민영' AND extsh_dt IS NULL GROUP BY emd_cd ) SELECT a.emd_cd, a.sgg_nm, a.emd_nm,
coalesce(c.cvlcpt_cnt, 0) AS cvlcpt_cnt, coalesce(d.cctv_crdn_cnt, 0) AS cctv_crdn_cnt, coalesce(d.pda_crdn_cnt, 0) AS pda_crdn_cnt, coalesce(d.fld_crdn_cnt, 0) AS fld_crdn_cnt, coalesce(s.pklt_cpcty_sum, 0) AS pklt_cpcty_sum FROM parking.tb_admdst a LEFT JOIN c ON c.emd_cd = a.emd_cd LEFT JOIN d ON d.emd_cd = a.emd_cd LEFT JOIN s ON s.emd_cd = a.emd_cd
WHERE a.emd_cd IN #{cd}
ORDER BY a.emd_cd
SELECT count(*) FROM parking.tb_plcy_smlt_rslt r JOIN parking.tb_anls_excn e ON e.excn_id = r.excn_id WHERE e.anls_type_cd = 'POLICY_SIM' AND e.excutr_id = #{userId}

SELECT r.rslt_id, e.excn_dt, e.anls_param_json ->> 'plcyType' AS plcy_type, e.anls_param_json ->> 'expandMethod' AS expand_method, (e.anls_param_json ->> 'addPkltSlot')::int AS add_pklt_slot, (e.anls_param_json ->> 'predcMm')::int AS predc_mm, e.anls_param_json ->> 'sggNm' AS sgg_nm, e.anls_param_json ->> 'emdCd' AS emd_cd, (e.anls_param_json -> 'vrblAjmt')::text AS vrbl_ajmt_json, r.anls_rng_cn, r.crtr_cvlcpt_cnt, r.crtr_ilgl_cnt, r.crtr_cngst_idx, r.exs_pklt_cpcty, r.vld_add_pklt_slot, r.cvlcpt_rdct_rt, r.cngst_impv_rt, r.aftr_cngst_idx, r.aftr_cvlcpt_cnt, r.calc_stts_cd, r.excs_yn, r.cst_lvl_cd, r.road_mtnc_type, r.road_mtnc_len, r.adjc_cvlcpt_cnt, r.fee_aplcn_mthd, r.fee_aplcn_zone, r.fee_incrs_rt, r.aplcn_trgt_slot, r.lvng_vhcl_cnt, r.absrp_cnt, r.trnsf_cnt, r.aplcn_param_json::text AS aplcn_param_json FROM parking.tb_plcy_smlt_rslt r JOIN parking.tb_anls_excn e ON e.excn_id = r.excn_id WHERE e.anls_type_cd = 'POLICY_SIM' AND e.excutr_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e.excn_dt DESC, r.rslt_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT coalesce(max(substring(p.rptp_nm from '^' || #{ymd} || '\((\d+)\)_정책 시뮬레이션 시나리오 비교$')::int), 0) FROM parking.tb_rptp p WHERE p.creatr_id = #{userId} AND p.rptp_nm ~ ('^' || #{ymd} || '\((\d+)\)_정책 시뮬레이션 시나리오 비교$')

SELECT DISTINCT b.emd_cd FROM parking.tb_admdst a JOIN parking.tb_admdst b ON a.emd_cd <> b.emd_cd AND ST_Intersects(a.bndry_geom, b.bndry_geom)
WHERE a.emd_cd IN #{cd} AND b.emd_cd NOT IN #{cd}
WHERE false
ORDER BY b.emd_cd

SELECT p.excn_id, e.anls_type_cd, r.rslt_json::text AS rslt_json FROM parking.tb_rptp p LEFT JOIN parking.tb_anls_excn e ON e.excn_id = p.excn_id LEFT JOIN parking.tb_anls_rslt r ON r.excn_id = p.excn_id WHERE p.rptp_id = #{rptpId}
